audience: finance and billing teams who meter usage and bill customers with Amberflo

useCases.title: Compare usage across customers for a period
useCases.text: The AI gets total usage across all meters for a time range, grouped by customer. You see who used the most and can compare customers.

useCases.title: Find out why a meter number looks wrong
useCases.text: The AI queries the usage of one meter, then reads the raw meter events behind it for the same time range. It helps you spot odd or duplicate events.

useCases.title: Check a customer's plan, history and prepaid credit
useCases.text: The AI shows the latest product plan of a customer, the plans they had before, and their active prepaid credit orders for a product.

useCases.title: List unpaid invoices and read the open one
useCases.text: The AI lists the invoices of a customer with their payment status and opens the current open invoice or a past one. You see what is still unpaid.

useCases.title: Add a customer and assign a pricing plan
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer with id, name, email and traits, and attaches a product plan to them. This changes what the customer is billed.
